task.title: Record the failure-analysis request brought inside its L1.8 ceiling on L1 and L5b
task.objective: At 42655904 the production failure-analysis request meets the 180 s L1.8 ceiling at its own output cap on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B: a 256-token cap with an answer sized to fit it, one text block plus routes, and whole-line evidence with only shown ids offered. verify:ai-failure-analysis-live is 5/5 with every answer accepted and classified, largest 94.0 s of inference and 126.4 s at the cap where it was 135.0 s and 219.3 s, and benchmark:ai-model-0-8b now measures the product's own request, failureAnalysisAtCap 132320 ms, GO on all 8. Append a note to awkit-djnl.1 giving the fix, the measurement and what stays open (the locator request at its 512-token cap, the pin, the license notice, verify:ai-model-pack, verify:ai-model-live and the live quality gates). Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 that its request and answer were resized under the same three trust rules. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: awkit-djnl.1 and awkit-djnl.8 stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/ai-harness/locatorUpgradePacket.ts and scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.1 and awkit-djnl.8 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the fix commit and the live and benchmark results, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, against the state after `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd update awkit-djnl.8 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents. The tracker measured 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, so the hardcoded tracker pin did not move. Both narratives restate the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.
